# nproc

Print the number of Linux processing units.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/nproc --all
```

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--all` | Count configured CPUs, ignoring quotas and OpenMP. |
| `--ignore VALUE` | Exclude N processors, retaining at least one. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

The default follows the current process affinity, OpenMP thread settings and the CPU quota hierarchy on a standard cgroup v2 mount. Realtime scheduling policies ignore quotas. --all counts configured CPU directories from sysfs. Nonstandard cgroup v2 mounts are rejected.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
